name: AEGISSAFETYDATASET
description: AEGISSAFETYDATASET is a dataset of approximately 26,000 human-LLM interaction instances annotated according to a broad content safety risk taxonomy covering 13 critical and 9 sparse risk categories. It is designed to benchmark and improve content safety moderation in large language models.
reputation: A relatively new safety dataset that has been used in recent content moderation and AI safety work, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes a broad safety risk taxonomy and supports evaluation of LLM-based safety models; used in alignment and online adaptation frameworks.
